simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רִבּוֹ (H7240) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רִבּוֹ (ribbôw) means × ten thousand times ten thousand. First listed occurrence: Dan 7 10.

definitions.full: H7240. ribbo רִבּוֺ (K § 65, 4 ) noun feminine myriad ( ᵑ7 Syriac); — absolute ׳ר + plural רבון Kt (read רִבְּיָן K l.c .), רִבְבָן Qr Dan 7:10 a myriad myriads .
